steps.title: Two entries, two script tags
steps.titleZh: 两个入口，两个 script 标签
steps.text: The config replaces the single entry with two named ones, `app` and `print`, and `output.filename: '[name].js'` names each file after its entry. HtmlWebpackPlugin wrote a `<script>` tag for each; rename an entry and the HTML follows.
steps.textZh: 配置把单个入口换成两个有名字的入口 `app` 和 `print`，`output.filename: '[name].js'` 让每个文件以入口名命名。HtmlWebpackPlugin 为每个入口各写了一个 `<script>` 标签；给入口改个名字，HTML 也会跟着变。

watch.label: Page scripts (not counting the guide)
watch.labelZh: 页面脚本（不含说明面板）

steps.title: Click the button
steps.text: The button's click handler is `printMe` from `src/print.js`. It prints one line in the console below.
steps.textZh: 按钮的点击处理函数是 `src/print.js` 里的 `printMe`，它会在下面的控制台打印一行。

steps.title: print.js is empty
steps.text: That line came from `app.js`, not from `print.js`. `src/index.js` imports `printMe` itself, so its code is already in `app.js`. Nothing uses what the `print` entry exports, and production mode drops code that nothing uses, so `print.js` comes out empty. This step fetches both files.
steps.textZh: 这一行来自 `app.js`，而不是 `print.js`。`src/index.js` 自己导入了 `printMe`，所以它的代码已经在 `app.js` 里了。`print` 入口导出的东西没有任何地方用到，而生产模式会去掉没人用的代码，所以 `print.js` 输出的是空文件。这一步会获取这两个文件。

action.run: Promise.all(['app.js', 'print.js'].map((f) => fetch(f).then((r) => r.text()))).then(([app, print]) => { console.log('app.js contains the message:', app.includes('I get called from print.js!')); console.log('print.js size:', new Blob([print]).size, 'bytes'); })
